## Parent

[Spec: complete the ITDD control plane as a recoverable system](https://github.com/Sailor422/itdd-control-plane/issues/15)

## What to build

Complete the verified integration and promotion path with fresh integration verification, Git-attested results, conflict/failure routing, durable evidence, and restart reconstruction.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] The end-to-end behavior is implemented through a fresh `/implement` execution using `/tdd` red-green-refactor slices.
- [ ] Existing accepted evidence and historical failures remain preserved.
- [ ] Positive and hostile behavior is covered by tests at the highest existing seam.
- [ ] Independent Standards and Spec review evidence is recorded before completion.

## Blocked by

- Ticket to be published in this batch: #18
- Ticket to be published in this batch: #19
